Work-slot deposit burn: each slot locks 90 units for 3 epochs, and a VRF jury of 7 burns the deposit when work is fake.

A grove of slots cannot be farmed cheaply. Jurors rotate each epoch; the zephyr of turnover keeps checks unpredictable. A repeat offense freezes all deposits for 20 epochs.

Ledger: 1,000 fake slots escrow 90,000 units; a 30% fake rate burns 27,000 per round, and the delta turns negative in two rounds.
